essay: The school should provide more trees because they give shade and improve the environment. Students could also learn from caring for them.
Schools should plant trees. Trees provide shade and cleaner air, and students can learn responsibility by caring for them.
I think schools need more trees. A greener campus can make the place nicer and can give students a chance to understand nature.
Planting trees at school is a useful idea because trees help the environment and make outdoor spaces more comfortable for students.

Schools should plant trees around the campus. They provide shade, help air quality, and create practical opportunities for students to learn about the environment. A small planting program could involve classes in planning, planting, and caring for the trees throughout the year.

More trees would benefit our school in several ways. First, they can provide shade during hot weather. Second, plants contribute to a healthier environment. Finally, a tree-care project could teach students patience and responsibility while improving the appearance of the campus.

A school tree program could be valuable if it is planned carefully. Students could research suitable species, estimate costs, plant the trees, and monitor their growth. This would combine environmental benefits with a practical learning activity and could encourage students to think about long-term community improvements.

The proposal deserves support because it connects education with a visible improvement to the school. However, the school should consider maintenance, available space, and water use before planting. With a clear plan and student participation, the project could provide environmental, educational, and community benefits.
Trees make school grounds pleasant and useful. They give shade and can help students appreciate nature.
Adding trees would help our school because students could sit under them and the campus would have more plants. The project would also give students something practical to care for.
A careful tree planting plan can improve the school environment. Students can help choose locations and maintain the plants, so the project has both environmental and educational value.

The school should plant more trees, but it should first study costs, water requirements, available land, and suitable species. A well-managed program could improve the campus while creating a long-term environmental learning activity for students.
